sources.snippet: Banglish Companion — Banglish Conversational AI The first Banglish conversational AI model. A casual, friendly chatbot that speaks in Banglish — Bengali written phonetically in Latin script. Runs locally, no GPU needed. Why Banglish? Over 230 million people speak Bengali.
